default/32325-1.htm.text: Yin: The elemental attributes of water, fire, wind and earth, and the holy and dark attributes that symbolizes light and darkness, are extensions of the gods who correspond to each attribute and are the source of magic power. Attribute magic flows through the matter of this world, causing action an…

Q10275_ContainingTheAttributePower/32325.text: Attribute Master Yin: Ah, Trader Holly sent you? News of my troubles must have finally reached him. The situation is urgent, so there is no time to waste. How about it? Will you help me?
Attribute Master Yin: You haven't found them yet? Why not?

links.text: "The device disappeared. Can you give me another one?"

Q10275_ContainingTheAttributePower/32325.text: Attribute Master Yin: An excellent start! Considering the time limit, you did very well. But you have not yet caught enough of the creatures. As things now stand, our experiment is still in danger. Please -- I still need your help. Capture more Reckless Sprites of Water . This time, I will use my m…

links.text: "I never like leaving a job half-finished."

Q10275_ContainingTheAttributePower/32325.text: Attribute Master Yin: You succeeded! Thank you. I'd like to give you something as a reward, but all that I have here are my research notes about attributes. Hmm... I can give you an Attribute Ore. It has value, so you won't regret acccepting it. Since you have completed my request twice, I'll give …

Attribute Master Yin: My disciples and I were conducting an experiment. We hoped to derive a greater attribute power. But the sprites we were studying became...problematic. Some of the Sprites of Water became increasingly reckless when injected with the attribute power, and they escaped from the la…

Attribute Master Yin: I appreciate your help. Unfortunately, it won't be easy. You must recapture the Reckless Sprites of Water using this device. They are still precious experimental subjects, remember. If they are killed, all our work will have been in vain. This device changes the materialized e…

Attribute Master Yin: I'll explain again. Capture the Reckless Sprites of Water and bring me 6 Reckless Sprite Pieces - Water . Remember to use the device I gave you. Otherwise, you'll do more harm than good...
Attribute Master Yin: I guess you need more time to recapture those reckless sprites, eh? Well, here you go. Please hurry!

Attribute Master Yin: The device disappeared, you say? But it's in your hand! Since it's obviously not at full strength, though, let me give you a new one to maximize your time. Here it is. Now please hurry!
Attribute Master Yin: Can you feel the effects of my magic? It should be very helpful in capturing those Reckless Sprites of Water . Now please hurry!

Attribute Master Yin: I will give you a Coarse Ore Fire that will strengthen the power of a Fire attribute. It may not look impressive, but its effects will be adequate. If you want something more, you will have to work harder. I suppose that concludes our business together. Farewell!
